description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetListAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It manages request parameters, handles access control, and returns a collection of employee timesheet models, supporting sorting and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving a list of employee timesheets, with support for filtering, sorting, pagination, and access control.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of employee timesheets based on request parameters, access rights, and search filters, returning a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, including optional employee number filtering and sorting/pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as creation of timesheets via this API is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, deletion via this API is not supported.
